
## Set up

```{julia}
using CSV
using DataFrames
using Interpolations
```

## Balloon system properties

```{julia}
free_lift = 5.0 # grams
balloon_weight = 38*2 # gram
balloon_volume = 0.15*2 # m^3
payload_weight = 20.0 # gram
gas = "helium 97%"
```

## Define gas properties

Gas density table in kg/cu m at 101.325 kPa at MSL

```{julia}
df_gas = CSV.read("""
    "name","0deg","15deg"
    "hydrogen",0.0899,0.0852
    "helium",0.1786,0.1693
    "helium 97%",0.2120,0.2010
    "air",1.2920,1.2247
""" |> IOBuffer, DataFrame)

atmosphere_pressure_msl = 101.325 # kPa at MSL "standard pressure"
atmosphere_temperature_msl = 273.1 + 15.0 # Kelvin at standard temperature
```

## Computed balloon fill properties 

```{julia}
chosen_gas_density = only(df_gas[(df_gas.name .== gas),"15deg"])
air_density = only(df_gas[(df_gas.name .== "air"),"15deg"])
neck_lift = free_lift + payload_weight # gram
launch_gas_fill =
    (neck_lift + balloon_weight)/
    (air_density-chosen_gas_density)/1000.0

# system denisty is the total mass including payload
# divided by the balloon volume
gas_mass = chosen_gas_density * launch_gas_fill * 1000 # gram
total_mass = gas_mass + payload_weight + balloon_weight # gram
total_mass /= 1000 # convert to kg
system_density = total_mass / balloon_volume # kg/m^3

print("Neck lift          $(neck_lift) gram")
print("Gas fill at launch $(launch_gas_fill[1]) m^3")
print("Gas mass           $(gas_mass) gram")
print("Total mass         $(total_mass) kg")
print("System density     $(system_density) km/m^3")
```


## Define atmospheric profile

```{julia}
fname = "atmos.csv"
df_atmos = CSV.read(fname, DataFrame)
```

## Float calculations

```{julia}
# interpolate temperature based on density
temperature_at_float = LinearIntepolation(df_atmos.var"Den (Kg/cu m)",df_atmos.var"Temp (C)")(system_density)
internal_pressure =  (atmosphere_pressure_msl * launch_gas_fill ) / atmosphere_temperature_msl * (273.1 + temperature_at_float) / balloon_volume
external_pressure = LinearInterpolation(df_atmos.var"Den (Kg/cu m)",df_atmos.var"Pres (kPa)")(system_density)
balloon_altitude_meter = LinearInterpolation(df_atmos.var"Den (Kg/cu m)",df_atmos.var"Alt (m)")(system_density) # meters
balloon_altitude_feet = balloon_altitude_meter * 3.28

free_lift_ratio = free_lift / (balloon_weight + payload_weight + gas_mass)

differential_pressure_kpa = internal_pressure - external_pressure # kPa
differential_pressure_psi = differential_pressure_kpa * 0.145038 # psi

k = launch_gas_fill * df_atmos.var"P/T (kPa/K)"[end]
kov = k / balloon_volume
superpressure_onset_altitude = LinearInterpolation(df_atmos.var"P/T (kPa/K)", df_atmos.var"Alt (m)")(kov) # meter
superpressure_kpa = external_pressure * free_lift_ratio
```
